High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad

sentences.text:
Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc:173297
Court No. - 66

Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 40148 of 2024
Applicant :- Smt. Lilawati

Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Mukesh Kumar Pandey,Prashant Singh
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Sameer Jain,J.
1.

Heard Sri Mukesh Kumar Pandey, learned counsel for the applicant and Sri Jhamman Ram,
learned AGA-I for the State.

2. The instant bail application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No.333 of 2024, under Sections 498A, 304B IPC and Section 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station Kaptanganj, District Kushinagar, during pendency of the trial.

3. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that applicant is mother-in-law of the deceased and on the basis of false allegation of demand of dowry and torture, she has been made accused along with her other family members including husband of the deceased.
4. He further submits, Postmortem suggests, deceased died due to hanging, therefore, prima facie, it appears to be a case of suicidal death.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: He next submits that on the basis of false allegation of demand of dowry and torture only being mother-in-law of the deceased, applicant has been made accused in the present matter.

He next submits that immediately after the alleged incident, the informant side was informed and informant arrived at spot and on his application Inquest was conducted and from perusal of the GD Entry dated 29.06.2024, it reflects that in the application dated 29.06.2024, informant did not make any allegation of demand of dowry and GD Entry dated 29.06.2024 has been annexed at page 18 of the paper book.
6.

He further submits that even from the Inquest Report, it reflects that at the time of Inquest,
applicant was one of the Inquest witness and it appears, subsequently, FIR of the present case was lodged on the basis of false allegation of demand of dowry and torture.
7. He further submits that applicant is not having any criminal history and in the present matter applicant is in jail since 26.07.2024.

8. Per contra, learned AGA however opposed the prayer for bail but could not dispute the fact that applicant is mother-in-law of the deceased and there is no specific allegation against her and Postmortem Report of the deceased suggests that deceased died due to hanging.

Learned AGA further could not dispute the fact that on the application moved by the informant, Inquest was conducted and in the application dated 29.06.2024, he did not make any allegation with regard to demand of dowry and torture.
9.
I have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record of the case.

10. Considering the fact that applicant is mother-in-law of the deceased and there is no specific allegation against her and from perusal of the Postmortem Report, it reflects that deceased died due to hanging, in my view, applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
11. Accordingly, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the instant bail application is allowed.

12. Let the applicant-Smt. Lilawati, be released on bail in the aforesaid case on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:-
(i) The applicant shall appear before the trial court on the dates fixed, unless her personal presence is exempted.
(ii) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly, make inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
(iii) The applicant shall not indulge in any criminal and anti-social activity.

14. It is clarified that the observations made herein are limited to the facts brought in by the parties pertaining to the disposal of bail application and the said observations shall have no bearing on the merits of the case during trial.
